## Load data

```{r}
# attributes 
l_orov <- readRDS(here::here("1_data", "05_clean_data" ,"orov_out_attributes.RData")) 
list2env(l_orov, envir = .GlobalEnv)

# dataset 
orov_all <- readRDS(here::here("1_data", "05_clean_data","orov_out_clean_final_2026-10-01.RData")) 
```

## Overview

```{r}
## all 
orov_all |>
  mutate(
    across(where(~ inherits(.x, "difftime")), as.numeric)
  ) |>
select(where(is.numeric)) |>
  skim()

# by site
orov_all |>
  mutate(
    across(where(~ inherits(.x, "difftime")), as.numeric)
  ) |>
select(site, age, n_sx, platelets_lab) |>
  group_by(site) |>
  skim()
```

Age, platelet_lab and n_sx are normally distributed overall but not across site. Keep as median + IQR

## Missing data analysis

```{r}
vis_miss(orov_all)

n_total_na <- sum(is.na(orov_all))

n_complete_case <- sum(!complete.cases(orov_all))

l_orov[["n_total_na"]] <- n_total_na
l_orov[["n_complete_case"]] <- n_complete_case
```

There are `r n_total_na` missing values in the dataset. The number of individuals with at least one missing value is `r n_complete_case`.

## Values reported in manuscript

```{r}

tab_dates <- orov_all |>
  filter(!is.na(sx_length)) |>
  select(sx_date,sx_end, sx_length, time_sx_to_pcr_urine, time_sx_to_pcr_urine_fu) |>
  mutate(time_sx_to_pcr_urine_combined = pmax(time_sx_to_pcr_urine, time_sx_to_pcr_urine_fu, na.rm = T)) |>
  tbl_summary(
    type = list(c(sx_date, sx_end, time_sx_to_pcr_urine, time_sx_to_pcr_urine_fu, time_sx_to_pcr_urine_combined) ~ "continuous2"),
    statistic = list(
      c(sx_date, sx_end, time_sx_to_pcr_urine, time_sx_to_pcr_urine_fu, time_sx_to_pcr_urine_combined) ~ c("{median} ({p25}-{p75})", "{min}-{max}")
    )
  )

tab_dates

l_orov[["tab_dates"]] <- tab_dates

range_dx_date <- orov_all |>
  select(contains("date"), -c(travel_date, hospitalization_date, sx_date, consult_date, compl_date, icu_date, death_date)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything()) |>
  summarise(
    min = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max  = max(value, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

l_orov[["range_dx_date"]] <- range_dx_date

# Create a paragraph with number and name of each sx
word_counts <- orov_all %>%
  select(other_sx) %>%
  separate_rows(other_sx, sep = ",") %>%             # split by commas
  mutate(other_sx = str_to_sentence(str_trim(other_sx)), # remove spaces around items
         other_sx = str_replace(other_sx, "edema", "oedema"),
         other_sx = str_replace(other_sx, "Edema", "Oedema"),
         other_sx = str_replace(other_sx, "fetal", "foetal"),
         other_sx = str_replace(other_sx, "Dyspnea", "Dyspnoea"),
         other_sx = str_replace(other_sx, "Conjuctivite", "Conjunctivitis"),
         other_sx = str_replace(other_sx, "Enantema", "Enanthema")
  ) %>%          
  count(other_sx, sort = TRUE) |>
  filter(other_sx!="None" &!is.na(other_sx))

paragraph_other_sx <- word_counts %>%
  mutate(text = paste0(n, " ", other_sx)) %>%
  summarise(paragraph = str_c(text, collapse = ", ")) %>%
  pull(paragraph)

paragraph_other_sx

l_orov[["paragraph_other_sx"]] <- paragraph_other_sx

l_ethnicity_disagg<- as.list(table(orov_all$ethnicity2)[c(1,3,4,8)])

l_orov[["l_ethnicity_disagg"]] <- l_ethnicity_disagg

# available ct data per severity
orov_all$ct_available <-  ifelse(!is.na(orov_all$orov_serum_ct),"Yes", "No")
ct_tab <- table(orov_all$complication2, orov_all$ct_available, useNA = "ifany")
ct_tab
round(prop.table(ct_tab, margin =2)*100,2) # column
round(prop.table(ct_tab, margin =1)*100,2) # row, default

sum(is.na(orov_all$orov_serum_ct)) == sum(orov_all$ct_available=="No")


# hospitalization median by severity 
hospitalization_tab <- df_hospitalization_times  |>
  mutate(cases_considered_severe = relevel(
    factor(cases_considered_severe),
    ref = "Yes"
  )) |>
  tbl_summary(
    by = cases_considered_severe,
    include = days_admission,
    type = list(c(days_admission) ~ "continuous2"),
    statistic = list(c(days_admission)~c("{median} ({p25}-{p75})", "{min}-{max}")),
    missing_text = "Missing"
  )|>
  add_overall()


l_orov[["hospitalization_tab"]] <- hospitalization_tab
```

## Clean dataset strings for manuscript tables and figures

```{r}

skip_words <- c("de", "do")
orov_clean <- orov_all |> 
   mutate(sex =str_replace_all(sex,"M","Male"),
         sex =str_replace_all(sex,"F","Female"),
         sex = ifelse(is.na(sex), "Not declared", sex),
         across(c(sex, ethnicity3, final_outcome), ~ fct_infreq(.)),
         site2 = factor(
           case_when(
             site == "bananeiras" ~ "Paraíba",
             site == "ceara" ~ "Ceará",
             site == "darien" ~ "Darién",
             site == "rio" ~ "Rio de Janeiro",
             site == "manaus" ~ "Amazonas",
             site == "yurimaguas" ~ "Loreto",
             T ~ str_to_title(site)
               ), levels = c("Ceará", "Darién", "Espirito Santo", "Paraíba", "Pernambuco", "Rio de Janeiro", "Amazonas", "Loreto")
           
         ),
          across(c(site,adult_vs_ped, city_residence), ~ Reduce( # capitalize names except de 
          function(txt, w)
            str_replace_all(txt,
              regex(paste0("\\b", str_to_title(w), "\\b")),
              w
            ),
          skip_words,
          init = str_to_title(.x)
        )
         ),
         site = factor(site, 
                       levels = str_to_title(c("bananeiras", "ceara", "darien", "espirito santo", "pernambuco", "rio","manaus", "yurimaguas"))),
        compl_others = case_when(
          cns_involvment == "severe headache" ~ "severe headache",
          T ~compl_others),
          compl_others= str_to_sentence(str_extract(compl_others,regex("Arthritis|Shock|severe headache", ignore_case = T))),
        cns_involvment = str_to_sentence(str_extract(cns_involvment, "limb weakness|Agitation")),
        across(c(iotropic,iv, respiratory, renal_compl,hepatic, cardiac), ~ifelse(!is.na(.)&.!= "No", "Yes", as.character(.))),
        no_organ_support = if_else(
          if_all(c(iotropic, iv, dialysis, ventilated), ~ .x != "Yes" | is.na(.x)),
          "Yes",
          "No"
        ),
        pregnancy_outcomes = 
          case_when(
            str_detect(pregnancy_outcomes, "TPL|Down|defect") ~ "Other",
            str_detect(pregnancy_outcomes, "fever") ~ "Symptomatic newborn",
            is.na(pregnancy_outcomes) ~ NA,
            T ~ pregnancy_outcomes),
        pregnancy_outcomes = case_when(
          str_detect(pregnancy_outcomes, regex("Abortion", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Abortion",
          str_detect(pregnancy_outcomes, regex("Stillbirth", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Stillbirth",
          str_detect(pregnancy_outcomes, regex("Preterm", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Preterm",
          str_detect(pregnancy_outcomes, regex("Symptomatic newborn", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Symptomatic newborn",
          str_detect(pregnancy_outcomes, regex("microcephaly", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Newborn with microcephaly",
          str_detect(pregnancy_outcomes, regex("reported|no complication", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Completed pregnancies with no complications",
          !is.na(pregnancy_outcomes) ~ "Other",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        ),
        # Convert to factor with defined level ordering
    pregnancy_outcomes = factor(
      pregnancy_outcomes,
      levels = c(
        "Abortion",
        "Stillbirth",
        "Preterm",
        "Symptomatic newborn",
        "Newborn with microcephaly",
        "Completed pregnancies with no complications",
        "Other"
      )
    ),
    # Put "Other" at the end while sorting the rest by frequency if desired
    pregnancy_outcomes = fct_relevel(pregnancy_outcomes, "Completed pregnancies with no complications", after = Inf),
      final_outcome = fct_infreq(
        case_when(
          final_outcome == "Inpatient"  ~ "Hospitalisation in general ward",
          final_outcome == "ICU-level care" ~"Intensive unit",
          T ~ final_outcome
        )
      )
  )




l_orov[["orov_clean"]] <- orov_clean
```

## Tables

### Table 1 Demographic & Epidemiological data

**Revision changes: added back missing values to the tables**

**Table 1**

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: demographic & epidemiological data by site

demo <- orov_clean |> 
  select(age, age_cat,sex, ethnicity3, year, case_type, education, pregnancy,
         n_comorb, hypertension, diabetes, immuno, 
         n_co_inf, dengue:co_inf_other, site2, adult_vs_ped, endemic_area)|>
  mutate(year = as.factor(year))

v_var_strat <- c("site2","adult_vs_ped", "endemic_area" )

v_yes <- c("pregnancy", "diabetes", "hypertension", "immuno"
           )


demo_site_tab <- create_summary_table_miss(
  data = demo,
  by_var = "site2",
  v_strat = v_var_strat,
  var_yes = v_yes,
  type_list = list(
    age ~ "continuous2"
  ),
  stat_list = list(
    age ~ c("{median} ({p25}-{p75})", "{min}-{max}")
  ),
  set_na_option = "no" # this will remove the missing rows for continuous data because categorical data already has unknown added as a level 
) |>
  remove_row_type(variables = c("diabetes", "hypertension"), 
                  type = "level", level_value = "Unknown") # remove the missing row of some of the comorbidity data 

demo_site_tab


l_orov[["demo_site_tab"]] <- demo_site_tab
```

Separate table for pregnancy and merge later

```{r}

preg <- orov_clean |>

v_var_strat <- c("site2","adult_vs_ped", "endemic_area" )

preg$pregnancy_trimester <- as.factor(preg$pregnancy_trimester)



demo_site_preg_tab <- create_summary_table_miss(
```

### **Table 2. Clinical & laboratory**

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: clinical and laboratory by site
clin <- orov_clean %>% 
  select(c(site, site2,sex, endemic_area, adult_vs_ped, age_cat, housing_location, pregnancy, risk_factors,# stratif var
           sx_date:dizziness,n_sx, other_sx_bin, sx_recurrent, sequelae,temperature_celsius, tourniquete, # clinical presentation 
           complication, complication2,  compl_date:cns_involvment, n_haemorrhagic ,haemorrhagic, respiratory, renal_compl, hepatic, cardiac, compl_others, compl_bin,# complications
           final_outcome, dialysis:platelet_transfusion, no_organ_support,# final outcome
           orov_confirmation,
           orov_dx:nab_date_fu, orov_dx_nab, orov_dx_elisa, ,orov_dx_pcr, sx_date, sx_end,orov_urine_date, time_sx_to_dx, time_sx_to_pcr, time_sx_to_nab, time_sx_to_elisa, time_sx_to_igm, sx_length  # diagnosis
           )) 

l_orov[["clin"]] <- clin

# order the columns by how descending frequency
v_sx_names <- orov_clean |>
  select(fever:dizziness) |>
  colnames()

v_sx_names <- v_sx_names[
  order(colSums(clin[v_sx_names] == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE), decreasing = T) 
]

v_sx_names<- setdiff(v_sx_names, c("fatigue","chills", "photophobia","odynophagia","conjunct_injection", "malaise", "chest_pain", "limb_weakness")) 

clin_for_tab <- clin |>
  select(site2, endemic_area, adult_vs_ped, v_sx_names, 
         n_sx, 
         sx_length, 
         n_haemorrhagic,haemorrhagic, cns_involvment, respiratory, renal_compl, hepatic, cardiac,  compl_others, compl_bin, final_outcome:ventilated, iotropic:iv, no_organ_support,orov_confirmation, orov_dx_pcr,
         sero_igg, sero_igm, nab, time_sx_to_pcr, 
         ) |>
  select(-c(stiff_neck, mental, seizures))|>
  mutate(across(c(sx_length, time_sx_to_pcr, 
                  ),~as.integer(.)))
  
v_other_sx <- paste(
  na.omit(unique(orov_clean$other_sx)),
  collapse = ", "
)

l_orov[["v_other_sx"]] <- v_other_sx

mean_sx_length<- mean(clin$sx_length, na.rm = T) %>%
  round(digits = 0)

l_orov[["mean_sx_length"]] <- mean_sx_length

v_yes <- clin_for_tab |>
  select(fever:dizziness, n_haemorrhagic:cardiac, orov_dx_pcr, sero_igg, sero_igm, dialysis:iv) |>
  colnames()




compl_cols <- setdiff(compl_cols, c("chest_pain","stiff_neck", "seizures",      "limb_weakness", "compl_life_threat"))

remove_na_var <- c(compl_cols, "iotropic", "iv", "dialysis", "ventilated", "sero_igg", "sero_igm")

clin_site_tab <- create_summary_table_miss(
  data = clin_for_tab,
  v_strat = v_var_strat,
  var_yes = v_yes,
  by= "site2",
  type_list = list(
    c(sx_length, time_sx_to_pcr) ~ "continuous2"
  ),
  stat_list = list(
    starts_with("sero_") ~ "{n}/{N} ({p}%)",
    c(sx_length, time_sx_to_pcr) ~ c("{median} ({p25}, {p75})", "{min}, {max}")
  )
)|>
  remove_row_type(variable=remove_na_var, type = "level", level_value = "Unknown")



clin_site_tab


l_orov[["clin_site_tab"]] <- clin_site_tab
```

### S7. Lab values

```{r}


# extract p_id of ES except wbc results

 v_p_id_no_lab_es <- orov_clean |>
  filter(
    if_all(-all_of("wbc_lab") & all_of(lab_values), is.na) &
    site == "Espirito Santo" #select all that do not have a lab result except wbc_lab
  ) |>
   pull(p_id)


# select the variables of interest 
 lab <- orov_clean |>
   select(p_id, haemoglobin_lab:lymphocytes_lab_low, site2, complication2)|>
  filter(!p_id %in% v_p_id_no_lab_es)|>
     filter(if_any(all_of(category_names), ~ !is.na(.))) |>
   mutate(across(category_names, ~str_to_sentence(.)),
         across(category_names, ~ factor(.,levels = stringr::str_to_sentence(c("above", "within", "below")))))
 
  

lab_tab <- create_summary_table_lab(
  lab|>
    select(-c(p_id,normal_lab_values, complication2)),
  v_strat = v_var_strat,
  var_yes = c("haematocrit_lab_elevated", "platelets_lab_low", "lymphocytes_lab_low", "creatinine_lab_elevated", "alt_lab_elevated"),
  by= "site2",
  stat_list =  list(
    all_categorical() ~ "{n}/{N} ({p}%)",
    all_dichotomous() ~ "{n}/{N} ({p}%)"
  )
)|>
  modify_column_hide(columns = c(stat_1, stat_2, stat_4, stat_5))

lab_tab

l_orov[["df_lab"]] <- lab # those with lab test available

l_orov[["lab_tab"]] <- lab_tab
```
